import sys, random, itertools, json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp_tests')
from harness import ok

def brute(queries, matrix, profiles):
    pairs = [(a,b) for a,b in itertools.combinations(profiles,2)
             if any(matrix[q][a]!=matrix[q][b] for q in queries)]
    best = None
    n = len(queries)
    for r in range(n+1):
        for combo in itertools.combinations(range(n), r):
            sel = set(combo)
            if all(any(matrix[queries[i]][a]!=matrix[queries[i]][b] for i in combo) for a,b in pairs):
                cost = sum(queries_cost[queries[i]] for i in combo)
                cand = (cost, len(combo))
                if best is None or cand < best:
                    best = cand
    return best or (0,0)

random.seed(7)
for trial in range(300):
    np_ = random.randint(1,8)
    nq = random.randint(0,7)
    profiles = [{'id':'p%d'%i,'max_aliases':random.randint(0,3),'cname':random.choice(['follow','stop']),'wildcard':random.choice(['rfc','off','one-label'])} for i in range(np_)]
    names = ['a.test.','x.y.test.','block.test.','*.test.','sub.test.']
    queries = []
    queries_cost = {}
    used = set()
    for i in range(nq):
        qid = 'q%d'%i
        queries.append({'id':qid,'name':random.choice(names),'type':random.choice(['A','CNAME','TXT']),'cost':random.randint(1,9)})
        queries_cost[qid] = queries[-1]['cost']
    zones = [{"origin":"test.","records":[
        {"owner":"*.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"end.test."},
        {"owner":"end.test.","type":"A","data":"192.0.2.5"},
        {"owner":"leaf.block.test.","type":"TXT","data":"exists"},
        {"owner":"sub.test.","type":"A","data":"198.51.100.1"},
        {"owner":"*.sub.test.","type":"A","data":"198.51.100.2"},
        {"owner":"a.test.","type":"A","data":"192.0.2.9"}]}]
    doc = {'zones':zones,'profiles':profiles,'queries':queries,'observations':[]}
    res = ok(doc)
    pids = sorted(p['id'] for p in profiles)
    qids = sorted(q['id'] for q in queries)
    matrix = {}
    for run in res['runs']:
        matrix.setdefault(run['query'],{})[run['profile']] = (run['rcode'], frozenset((a['owner'],a['type'],a['data']) for a in run['answer']))
    qc = {q['id']:q['cost'] for q in queries}
    globals()['queries_cost'] = qc
    bc, bn = brute(qids, matrix, pids)
    d = res['diagnostic']
    # equivalence classes check
    groups = {}
    for p in pids:
        key = tuple(matrix[q][p] for q in qids)
        groups.setdefault(key, []).append(p)
    classes = sorted(sorted(g) for g in groups.values())
    assert d['equivalence'] == classes, (d['equivalence'], classes)
    assert (d['cost'], d['count']) == (bc, bn), (trial, d, (bc,bn))
    # verify basis itself separates
    pairs = [(a,b) for a,b in itertools.combinations(pids,2) if any(matrix[q][a]!=matrix[q][b] for q in qids)]
    for a,b in pairs:
        assert any(matrix[q][a]!=matrix[q][b] for q in d['basis']), (a,b,d)
    assert d['basis']==sorted(set(d['basis']))
    assert sum(qc[q] for q in d['basis'])==d['cost'] and len(d['basis'])==d['count']
print('BASIS BRUTE FORCE OK')
PYEOF
